answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the ledge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the meadow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ocean of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
